name: Delrin Front Top
description: Delrin Front Top by PQP. This top is interchangeable on the PQP Joystick Rest, Pappas Rest, and Randolph Machine Rests. The Delrin top works best with non-painted fiberglass stocks. It has a delrin piece on bottom for the forearm of the stock to ride on as well as Delrin pieces on each side to securely hold the rifle in place. The side pieces are spring loaded and the amount of tension is variable. This is ideal for 3.0″ Wide Forearm that is flat.
